scripts.check:quick: bash -c 'SECONDS=0; (cd .. && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v) && npm run typecheck; result=$?; echo "quick wall: ${SECONDS}s (budget 10s; 1s exit margin)"; (( SECONDS < 9 )) || exit 1; exit "$result"'
scripts.check:focused: bash -c 'SECONDS=0; (( $# > 0 )) || { echo "Pass a test file and optional -g filter" >&2; exit 2; }; export OFFICE_PRODUCTION=1 OFFICE_EVIDENCE_DIR=../artifacts/checks/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)-$$; echo "Evidence: $OFFICE_EVIDENCE_DIR"; npm run build && (( SECONDS < 28 )) && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=./.pw-browsers playwright test --global-timeout $(( (28-SECONDS)*1000 )) "$@"; result=$?; echo "focused wall: ${SECONDS}s (budget 30s; 1s exit margin)"; (( SECONDS < 29 )) || exit 1; exit "$result"' --
scripts.check:full: bash -c 'SECONDS=0; export OFFICE_PRODUCTION=1 OFFICE_EVIDENCE_DIR=../artifacts/checks/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)-$$; echo "Evidence: $OFFICE_EVIDENCE_DIR"; (cd .. && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v) && npm run build && (( SECONDS < 58 )) && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=./.pw-browsers playwright test --global-timeout $(( (58-SECONDS)*1000 )); result=$?; echo "full wall: ${SECONDS}s (budget 60s; 1s exit margin)"; (( SECONDS < 59 )) || exit 1; exit "$result"'
